errors.evidence: The exact values are only approximate, but the description misstates several bar heights, especially at low sparsities and at 70%/80%. The figure shows values near 5–6 for 10%–50%, around 9 and 11 at 60%, about 20 and 40 at 70%, and roughly 500 and 900 at 80%. The given ranges are sometimes too broad or not aligned with the visible bar heights.

The description explains the axes and bars but does not explicitly state the chart’s purpose as a comparison of perplexity at different sparsity rates in the context of per-output vs per-layer methods, though this is partially implied.
